_doc: Advisories the shared Security workflow (ValentinTorassa/.github, scripts/npm-audit.mjs) reports as warnings instead of failing. Each entry needs id, package, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and reason. Remove an entry once a release without the advisory is in the lockfile; the script flags entries that no longer match anything.

allow.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections; the first fixed zod is 4.6.6. No fix is reachable for the one remaining copy: zod 4.1.11, pinned exactly by @vercel/cli-config (every release up to 0.3.3, the latest), through @vercel/blob > @vercel/oidc. It only parses the local Vercel CLI config file during an OIDC token refresh, never request input. The other zod copy in the lockfile is already 4.6.7. Remove it once @vercel/cli-config moves to zod >= 4.6.6.
